name: Force FPS
description: Runs Geometry Dash's game loop at a custom FPS, independent of the screen's refresh rate.

substep.name: Run game at target FPS
substep.description: Runs the game's update loop several times per screen frame, so GD updates at your target FPS even if the screen is capped (e.g. 240 on a 90 Hz screen).

disable-vsync.name: Try to disable VSync (Android)
disable-vsync.description: Lets the phone draw frames beyond the screen's refresh rate. You can't see them, it makes FPS jump around and uses more battery. Leave off unless testing.
